note: Paper track, pre-registered before any results. Question: after each venue's real fees, does any exchange / prediction market offer prices better than Pinnacle's no-vig fair price often enough to beat the close? Basis: 1,481 logged game-snapshots (2026-09-29 to 10-02). Median two-way cost after fees: Kalshi 4.5%, Robinhood 5.0-5.1%, Polymarket 3.6-4.4%, ProphetX 1.4-2.0%, Novig 1.1-1.6%; share of quotes >= +1% vs Pinnacle fair: ProphetX ML 10.6%, Polymarket ML 8.2%, Kalshi ML 2.8%, Robinhood 0%. Quotes are top-of-book from The Odds API with no size, so some may be thin or stale (hence the freshness and max-EV guards). Do not edit to fit results; bump the version instead.

robinhood.label: Robinhood
robinhood.note: Robinhood NFL contracts are Kalshi's order book; price = Kalshi ask + Robinhood 1c commission + exchange fee (capped 1c)

novig.label: Novig
novig.note: not available in Arizona (logged for reference only)

betopenly.label: BetOpenly
betopenly.note: fees and Arizona availability unverified (reference only)

qualify.fair: Pinnacle no-vig probability (multiplicative) at the same snapshot, same market and same point (both sides quoted)
qualify.one_bet_per: game x market (first snapshot where any bettable venue qualifies; best EV venue/side at that snapshot)

grading.clv: decimal price after fees x Pinnacle no-vig probability of our side at the same point in our last odds snapshot before kickoff - 1; no same-point Pinnacle close = no CLV
grading.result: final score; spreads/totals pushes return the stake
